{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print("First 5 values of revenue:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for internal test orders
print("Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check status distribution
print("Status distribution:\n", df['status'].value_counts())

# Check if 'revenue' has commas
print("Example values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())"}
